narrative.overview: The website is the signal box seen from outside; the app is the panel the warden actually works at. It keeps the box's green-grey and cream, its plate-like primary buttons and its three lamp aspects, and drops everything decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Sidebar with counts instead of tabs; one title row per page.
Tunnels are dense rows grouped by profile; selecting one opens its log beside the list, never over it.
Green, amber and red mean tunnel state and nothing else, always beside the state word.
The pixel portal and warden appear only in the sidebar mark, the popover, first-run, empty states and the login-expired card.

rules.name: The Aspect Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean running, connecting and failed. They never decorate, and each one sits next to the word it means.

rules.name: The Amber Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus rings and text selection are amber, the one colour that marks what you are acting on.

rules.name: The No Display Type Rule
rules.body: Working screens use the system face only; the brand's display and plate faces stay on the website.

rules.name: The Beside, Not Over Rule
rules.body: Details open next to what they describe. Dialogs are for decisions and forms only.

dos: Do pair every state colour with its word.
Do keep the window still: scroll inside regions.
Do open details beside the list.
Do keep production starts behind a confirmation everywhere.
donts: Don't use blue or any accent for primary buttons; they are ink or cream plates.
Don't put coloured stripes down a row or card edge.
Don't put pixel art on working screens beyond the sidebar mark.
Don't repeat the login-expired card outside the Tunnels page.
